sources.title: Ideal Rocket Equation — NASA Glenn Research Center
Rocket Thrust Equation — NASA Glenn Research Center

not_established: These ideal equations do not model gravity loss, aerodynamic drag, staging, finite-burn steering or trajectory optimization.
The case does not model combustion chemistry, turbomachinery, injector dynamics, regenerative cooling, nozzle separation or transient startup.
A matching analytic result is not a measured thrust-stand result, material qualification, engine qualification or flight-readiness finding.
The illustrative numbers are chosen for equation verification and do not describe Prometheus, RAMPT or any specific flight engine.
